subject.name: Introduction to Indian constitution
subject.course_or_branch: BA in Socialogy Psychology Political Science

content: Meaning of the constitution law and constitutionalism, The History
of the Making of the Indian Constitution , Preamble and the Basic
Structure, and its Interpretation, Salient features and characteristics
of the Constitution of India , Fundamental Rights and Duties and
their Interpretation, Right to Equality under Article - 14, Right to
certain Freedom under Article 19, Scope of the Right to Life and
Personal Liberty under Article 21, Fundamental Duties and its legal
status , State Policy Principles- Its importance and Implementation
Structure of the Indian Union, President - Role and Power , Prime
Minister and Council of Ministers, Lok Sabha and Rajya Sabha Edit
Governor - Role and Power , Chief Minister and Council of
District Administration, Municipal Corporation, Zila Panchayat
Role and Functioning , Chief Election Commissioner, State Election
